TSAOG Orthopaedics & Spine, formerly The San Antonio Orthopaedic Group, was established by John J. Hinchey, MD, and has been a long-time provider of quality orthopaedic care since 1947. With a commitment to providing the highest standards of medical and surgical care, TSAOG has become the largest orthopaedic practice in San Antonio and South Texas. 

The physicians at TSAOG specialize in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries of the musculoskeletal system, including:

Joint replacement
Sports medicine injuries
Arthroscopic surgery
Spine treatment
Care and surgery of the shoulder, elbow, hand, wrist, knee, foot and ankle 

We also offer additional services, including:

Hand therapy and physical therapy
Industrial rehabilitation
Worker’s comp
Digital imaging
Outpatient surgery
Orthopaedic urgent care
